# Horror Scream1

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/horror-scream1

Downloaded source file:

- `scream_horror1.mp3`

License: CC0.

Usage in Blackout Hunt:

- `Tools/GenerateAudioSources.ps1` processes this into `Content/BlackoutHunt/Audio/Sources/BH_TerrifiedScream_Faint.wav`
- the processed scream is mixed into `BH_EerieLobbyLoop.wav`
- the processed scream is imported as `/Game/BlackoutHunt/Audio/SW_TerrifiedScreamFaint`
